verses.geez: ከመ፡ እብነ፡ ጾላዕ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሃካይ፡ በኀበ፡ ነበረ፡ ወያፀርዕ፡ ኵሎ፡ በኀሳረ፡ ሀኬቱ።
verses.translation: A slothful man is compared to a filthy stone, and every one will hiss him out to his disgrace.

translations.lxx: A slothful man is compared to a filthy stone, and every one will hiss him out to his disgrace.
translations.ron: Pietrei celei întinate s-a asemănat leneşul şi toţi vor şuiera spre batjocura lui.
translations.grk: Λίθῳ ἠρδαλωμένῳ συνεβλήθη ὀκνηρὸς, καὶ πᾶς ἐκσυριεῖ ἐπὶ τῇ ἀτιμίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ፅፍዕ፡ ግዱፍ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሀካይ፡ በኀበ፡ ሰከበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘቀተሎ፡ ነገፈ፡ እዴሁ።
verses.translation: A slothful man is compared to the filth of a dunghill: every man that takes it up will shake his hand.

translations.lxx: A slothful man is compared to the filth of a dunghill: every man that takes it up will shake his hand.
translations.ron: Asemenea unui morman de gunoi este leneşul; tot cel care îl va ridica îşi va scutura mâna.
translations.grk: Βολβίτῳ κοπρίων συνεβλήθη ὀκνηρὸς, πᾶς ὁ ἀναιρούμενος αὐτὸν ἐκτινάξει χεῖρα.

verses.geez: ኀፍረት፡ ለአቡ[ሁ]፡ውሉድ፡ አብድ፡ ወወለትሰ፡ አብድ፡ ኅስርተ፡ ትከውን።
verses.translation: An evil-nurtured son is the dishonour of his father that begat him: and a [foolish] daughter is born to his loss.

translations.lxx: An evil-nurtured son is the dishonour of his father that begat him: and a [foolish] daughter is born to his loss.
translations.ron: Ruşine tatălui este fiul neînvăţat; iar când este o fiică, ea s-a născut spre paguba părintelui său.
translations.grk: Αἰσχύνη πατρὸς ἐν γεννήσει ἀπαιδεύτου, θυγάτηρ δὲ ἐπʼ ἐλαττώσει γίνεται.

verses.geez: ወወለትሰ፡ ጠባብ፡ ትወርሶ፡ ለምታ፡ ወእንተሰ፡ ታስተኃፍር፡ ሐዘን፡ ይእቲ፡ ለወላዲሃ።
verses.translation: A wise daughter shall bring an inheritance to her husband: but she that liveth dishonestly is her father's heaviness.

translations.lxx: A wise daughter shall bring an inheritance to her husband: but she that liveth dishonestly is her father's heaviness.
translations.ron: Fiica înţeleaptă face bogat pe bărbatul său; iar cea fără de ruşine este de întristare celui ce a născut-o.
translations.grk: Θυγάτηρ φρονίμη κληρονομήσει ἄνδρα αὐτῆς, καὶ ἡ καταισχύνουσα, εἰς λύπην γεννήσαντος.

verses.geez: ወበኵለሄ፡ ተሐረምት፡ ምክዕቢተ፡ ታስተኃፍር፡ አባሃኒ፡ ወታስተኀፍር፡ ምታኒ፡ ዝልፍት።
verses.translation: She that is bold dishonoureth both her father and her husband, and they both shall despise her.

translations.lxx: She that is bold dishonoureth both her father and her husband, and they both shall despise her.
translations.ron: Fiica fără ruşine face să roşească şi pe tată şi pe bărbat şi de amândoi este dispreţuită.
translations.grk: Πατέρα καὶ ἄνδρα καταισχύνει ἡ θρασεῖα, καὶ ὑπὸ ἀμφοτέρων ἀμιμασθήσεται.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዘይሰነቁ፡ በቤተ፡ ላሕ፡ ዘይነግር፡ ቃሎ፡ በኀበ፡ ረከበ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ወተግሣጽ፡ በኵለሄ፡ ያጠብብ።
verses.translation: A tale out of season [is as] music in mourning: but stripes and correction of wisdom are never out of time.

translations.lxx: A tale out of season [is as] music in mourning: but stripes and correction of wisdom are never out of time.
translations.ron: Muzică în zi de întristare sunt mustrările nepotrivite; bătăile şi certarea în toată vremea sunt înţelepciune.
translations.grk: Μουσικὰ ἐν πένθει ἄκαιρος διήγησις, μάστιγες καὶ παιδεία ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ σοφίας.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዘያስተጣብቅ፡ አግዕልተ፡ ዘይሜህሮ፡ ለአብድ፡ አንቅሆ፡ እምዐቢይ፡ ንዋም፡ ለዘይነውም።

translations.ron: Cel care învaţă pe cel nebun este ca şi cel care lipeşte hârbul şi deşteaptă din somn greu pe cel care doarme.

verses.geez: (ከማሁ፡)ዘይነግሮ፡ ለአብድ፡ ከመ፡ ዘይነግሮ፡ ለድቁስ፡ ወሶበ፡ አኅለቀ፡ ነጊሮቶ፡ ይብለከ፡ ምንተ፡ ትቤ።

translations.ron: Ca şi cum ar povesti celui care dormitează, aşa este cel ce povesteşte celui nebun, şi la sfârşit va zice: Ce este?

verses.geez: ብክዮ፡ ለዘሞተ፡ እስመ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ወብክዮ፡ ለአብድ፡ እስመ፡ አምሠጦ፡ ልቡ። ርቱዕ፡ ትብክዮ፡ ለዘሞተ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ምግባአ፡ ወለአብድሰ፡ ብክዮ፡ በሕይወቱ፡ እስመ፡ ሐይው፡ የአክዮ፡ እምነ፡ መዊት።
verses.translation: Weep for the dead, for he hath lost the light: and weep for the fool, for he wanteth understanding: make little weeping for the dead, for he is at rest: but the life of the fool is worse than death.

translations.lxx: Weep for the dead, for he hath lost the light: and weep for the fool, for he wanteth understanding: make little weeping for the dead, for he is at rest: but the life of the fool is worse than death.
translations.ron: Plânsul pentru mort să fie şapte zile; iar pentru cel nebun şi nelegiuit, în toate zilele vieţii lui.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ νεκρῷ κλαῦσον, ἐξέλιπε γὰρ φῶς· καὶ ἐπὶ μωρῷ κλαῦσον, ἐξέλιπε γὰρ σύνεσις· ἥδιον κλαῦσον ἐπὶ νεκρῷ, ὅτι ἀνεπαύσατο, τοῦ δὲ μωροῦ ὑπὲρ θάνατον ἡ ζωὴ πονηρά.

verses.geez: ኢታብዝኅ፡ ተናግሮ፡ ምስለ፡ አብድ፡ ወኢትሖር፡ ምስለ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ልብ። ወተዐቀብ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያብእከ፡ ውስተ፡ ጻሕብ፡ ወከመ፡ አትትሐየስ፡ አንተ፡ በእበደ፡ ዚአሁ። ረሐቀ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወተዐርፍ፡ ነፍስከ፡(ወይቀልለከ)፤ ወአልቦ፡ ዘትት[ነከይ]፡አንተ፡ በእበደ፡ ዚአሁ።
verses.translation: Talk not much with a fool, and go not to him that hath no understanding: beware of him, lest thou have trouble, and thou shalt never be defiled with his fooleries: depart from him, and thou shalt find rest, and never be disquieted with madness.

translations.lxx: Talk not much with a fool, and go not to him that hath no understanding: beware of him, lest thou have trouble, and thou shalt never be defiled with his fooleries: depart from him, and thou shalt find rest, and never be disquieted with madness.
translations.ron: Fereşte-te de el, ca să nu ai necaz şi să nu te întinezi, atingându-te de el.
translations.grk: Μετὰ ἄφρονος μὴ πληθύνῃς λόγον, καὶ πρὸς ἀσύνετον μὴ πορεύου· φύλαξον ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἵνα μὴ κόπον ἔχῃς, καὶ οὐ μὴ μολυνθῇς ἐν τῷ ἐντιναγμῷ αὐτοῦ· ἔκκλινον ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ εὑρήσεις ἀνάπαυσιν, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀκηδιάσῃς ἐν τῇ ἀπονοίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ምንተ፡ ይከብድ፡ እምነ፡ ዐረር፡ ወምንተ፡ ስሙ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ አብድ።
verses.translation: What is heavier than lead? and what is the name thereof, but a fool?

translations.lxx: What is heavier than lead? and what is the name thereof, but a fool?
translations.ron: Fereşte-te de el şi vei afla odihnă şi nu te împovăra cu nebunia lui.
translations.grk: Ὑπὲρ μόλυβδον τί βαρυνθήσεται; καὶ τί αὐτῷ ὄνομα, ἀλλʼ ἢ μωρός;

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ትጾር፡ ኆጻ፡ ወፄወ፡ ወዘብርታተ፡ ኀጺን፡ እምትንበር፡ ምስለ፡ አብድ።
verses.translation: Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, are easier to bear, than a man without understanding.

translations.lxx: Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, are easier to bear, than a man without understanding.
translations.ron: Ce este mai greu decât plumbul şi cum se cheamă el? Nebunul.
translations.grk: Ἄμμον καὶ ἅλα καὶ βῶλον σιδήρου εὔκοπον ὑπενεγκεῖν, ἢ ἄνθρωπον ἀσύνετον.

verses.geez: መሠንየ፡ ማእሰር፡ ዘእሱር፡ ውስተ፡ ቅጽረ፡ ንድቅ፡ ወኢይትፈታሕ፡ ለእመኒ፡ አድለቅለቀ፡ ከማሁ፡ ምክረ፡ ጥበብ፡ ውስተ፡ ልበ፡ ጽኑዕ።
verses.translation: As timber girt and bound together in a building cannot be loosed with shaking: so the heart that is stablished by advised counsel shall fear at no time.

translations.lxx: As timber girt and bound together in a building cannot be loosed with shaking: so the heart that is stablished by advised counsel shall fear at no time.
translations.ron: Mai lesne este a purta nisip, sare şi fier, decât a locui cu un om fără minte.
translations.grk: Ἱμάντωσις ξυλίνη ἐνδεδεμένη εἰς οἰκοδομὴν ἐν συσσεισμῷ οὐ διαλυθήσεται, οὕτως καρδία ἐστηριγμένη ἐπὶ διανοήματος βουλῆς ἐν καιρῷ οὐ δειλιάσει.

verses.geez: ወኢይትፈታሕ፡ ቅጽሩ፡ ለዝላፉ፡ ለልብ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ወለምክረ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወከመ፡ መርገ፡ ኆጻ፡ በውስተ፡ አረፍት።
verses.translation: A heart settled upon a thought of understanding is as a fair plaistering on the wall of a gallery.

translations.lxx: A heart settled upon a thought of understanding is as a fair plaistering on the wall of a gallery.
translations.ron: Încheietura de lemn legată în zidul casei nu se va prăbuşi de cutremur; aşa inima cea întărită în cugetul sfatului, m nici un timp nu se va teme.
translations.grk: Καρδία ἡδρασμένη ἐπὶ διανοίας συνέσεως, ὡς κόσμος ψαμμωτὸς τοίχου ξυστοῦ.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ሐሠር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዐውሎ፡ ዘኢይቀውም፡ እምከመ፡ መጽአ፡ ነፋስ፡ ከማሁ፡ ኅሊና፡ አብድ፡ በውስተ፡ ልበ፡ ፈራህ፡ ዘኢይቀውም፡ ለእምከመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ዘገረሞ።
verses.translation: Pales set on an high place will never stand against the wind: so a fearful heart in the imagination of a fool cannot stand against any fear.

translations.lxx: Pales set on an high place will never stand against the wind: so a fearful heart in the imagination of a fool cannot stand against any fear.
translations.ron: Inima aşezată pe cugetul înţelegerii este ca podoaba cea făcută pe peretele neted.
translations.grk: Χάρακες ἐπὶ μετεώρου κείμενοι κατέναντι ἀνέμου οὐ μὴ ὑπομείνωσιν, οὕτως καρδία δειλὴ ἐπὶ διανοήματος μωροῦ κατέναντι παντὸς φόβου οὐ μὴ ὑπομείνῃ.

verses.geez: ዘደጐጸ፡ ዐይኖ፡ ያወርድ፡ አንብዐ፡ ወዘደጐጸ፡ ልቦ፡ ያርኢ፡ ጥበበ።
verses.translation: He that pricketh the eye will make tears to fall: and he that pricketh the heart maketh it to shew her knowledge.

translations.lxx: He that pricketh the eye will make tears to fall: and he that pricketh the heart maketh it to shew her knowledge.
translations.ron: Gardul înfipt în vârful dealului nu rămâne în picioare când îl izbeşte vijelia; aşa inima fricoasă, în cugetul nebunului, nu va sta înaintea oricărei frici.
translations.grk: Ὁ νύσσων ὀφθαλμὸν κατάξει δάκρυα, καὶ ὁ νύσσων καρδίαν ἐκφαίνει αἴσθησιν.

verses.geez: ዘወገሮን፡ ለአዕዋፍ፡ ይሰዶን፡ ወዘይዘረክዮ፡ ለዐርኩ፡ ሰዐረ፡ ታእኃሁ።
verses.translation: Whoso casteth a stone at the birds frayeth them away: and he that upbraideth his friend breaketh friendship.

translations.lxx: Whoso casteth a stone at the birds frayeth them away: and he that upbraideth his friend breaketh friendship.
translations.ron: Cel care împunge ochiul va scoate lacrimi, şi cel care împunge inima răscoleşte simţirea.
translations.grk: Βάλλων λίθον ἐπὶ πετεινὰ ἀποσοβεῖ αὐτὰ, καὶ ὁ ὀνειδίζων φίλον διαλύσει φιλίαν.

verses.geez: እመኒ፡ መላኅከ፡ መጥባሕተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዐርክከ።
verses.translation: Though thou drewest a sword at thy friend, yet despair not: for there may be a returning [to favour].

translations.lxx: Though thou drewest a sword at thy friend, yet despair not: for there may be a returning [to favour].
translations.ron: Cel care aruncă piatră asupra păsărilor le goneşte şi cel care ocărăşte pe prieten strică prietenia.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ φίλον ἐὰν σπάσῃς ῥομφαίαν, μὴ ἀπελπίσῃς, ἔστι γὰρ ἐπάνοδος.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ አዕበይከ፡ አፉከ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ኢትቅበጾ፡ በከመ፡ ይትዓረከከ። እንበለ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ለእመ፡ ዘርከይካሁ፡ ወአዕበይከ፡ አፉከ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወጸዐልካሁ፡ ወለእመኒ፡ ከሠትከ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምክሮ፡ ወተጓሕለውካሁ፡ ወአሕመምካሁ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ ይጐይይ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዐርክ።
verses.translation: If thou hast opened thy mouth against thy friend, fear not; for there may be a reconciliation: except for upbraiding, or pride, or disclosing of secrets, or a treacherous wound: for for these things every friend will depart.

translations.lxx: If thou hast opened thy mouth against thy friend, fear not; for there may be a reconciliation: except for upbraiding, or pride, or disclosing of secrets, or a treacherous wound: for for these things every friend will depart.
translations.ron: Asupra prietenului de vei scoate şi sabia, să nu te deznădăjduieşti, căci el n-o va întoarce asupra ta.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ φίλον ἐὰν ἀνοίξῃς στόμα, μὴ εὐλαβηθῇς, ἔστι γὰρ διαλλαγή· πλὴν ὀνειδισμοῦ, καὶ ὑπερηφανίας, καὶ μυστηρίου ἀποκαλύψεως, καὶ πληγῆς δολίας, ἐν τούτοις ἀποφεύξεται πᾶς φίλος.

verses.geez: ለእመኒ፡ ነዳይ፡ አንተ፡ ሃይማኖተከ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ምስለ፡ ቢጽከ፡ ከመ፡ ትትፈሣሕ፡ አመ፡ ትፍሥሕቱ። ለእመኒ፡ ተጸነሰ፡ ተዐገሥ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ከመ፡ ትትፈሣሕ፡ አመ፡ ይረክብ፡ ርስቶ፡ ምስሌሁ።
verses.translation: Be faithful to thy neighbour in his poverty, that thou mayest rejoice in his prosperity: abide steadfast unto him in the time of his trouble, that thou mayest be heir with him in his heritage.

translations.lxx: Be faithful to thy neighbour in his poverty, that thou mayest rejoice in his prosperity: abide steadfast unto him in the time of his trouble, that thou mayest be heir with him in his heritage.
translations.ron: Asupra prietenului de vei deschide gura, să nu te temi, că este împăcare,
translations.grk: Πίστιν κτῆσαι ἐν πτωχείᾳ μετὰ τοῦ πλησίον, ἵνα ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς αὐτοῦ ὁμοῦ πλησθῇς· ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως διάμενε αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐν τῇ κληρονομίᾳ αὐτοῦ συνκληρονομήσῃς.

verses.geez: ለእሳትኒ፡ ይቀድም፡ ይጠይስ፡ ተነ፡ ጢሱ፡ ከማሁ፡ ለደምኒ፡ ይቀድም፡ ላኳ፡ ወጋእዝ።
verses.translation: As the vapour and smoke of a furnace goeth before the fire; so reviling before blood.

translations.lxx: As the vapour and smoke of a furnace goeth before the fire; so reviling before blood.
translations.ron: Afară de batjocură, de trufie, de descoperirea tainei şi de rana vicleană, căci pentru acestea va fugi tot prietenul.
translations.grk: Πρὸ πυρὸς ἀτμὶς καμίνου καὶ καπνὸς, οὕτως πρὸ αἱμάτων λοιδορίαι.

verses.geez: ሰውሮቶ፡ ለዐርክየ፡ ኢየኀፍር፡ ወኢይትኀባእኒ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ።
verses.translation: I will not be ashamed to defend a friend; neither will I hide myself from him;

translations.lxx: I will not be ashamed to defend a friend; neither will I hide myself from him;
translations.ron: Să ai credinţă către aproapele tău întru sărăcia lui, ca împreună cu el să te saturi de bunătăţile lui, când va fi bogat.
translations.grk: Φίλον σκεπάσαι οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσομαι, καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ κρυβῶ,

verses.geez: ወአእመሰ፡ እኪት፡ ትረክበኒ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘሰምዐ፡ የዐቅብ፡ ርእሶ፡ እምኔሁ።
verses.translation: and if any evil happen unto me by him, every one that heareth it will beware of him.

translations.lxx: and if any evil happen unto me by him, every one that heareth it will beware of him.
translations.ron: În vremea nevoii lui să rămâi la el, ca întru moştenirea lui împreună să moşteneşti.
translations.grk: καὶ εἰ κακά μοι συμβῇ διʼ αὐτόν, πᾶς ὁ ἀκούων φυλάξεται ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይሠይም፡ ሊተ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ላዕለ፡ አፉየ፡ ወማኅተመ፡ ጥበብ፡ ዲበ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይደቅ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይቅትለኒ፡ ልሳንየ።
verses.translation: Who shall set a watch before my mouth, and a seal of wisdom upon my lips, that I fall not suddenly by them, and that my tongue destroy me not?

translations.lxx: Who shall set a watch before my mouth, and a seal of wisdom upon my lips, that I fall not suddenly by them, and that my tongue destroy me not?
translations.ron: Înaintea focului se arată întâi abur de cuptor şi fum; aşa înaintea vărsărilor de sânge, întâi înjurăturile.
translations.grk: Τίς δώσει μοι ἐπὶ στόμα μου φυλακὴν, καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν χειλέων μου σφραγίδα πανοῦργον, ἵνα μὴ πέσω ἀπʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου ἀπολέσῃ με;
